cases.prompt: almeno 4 brani dei Rolling Stones e 3 brani degli AC/DC e 2 brani dei Metallica
cases.failure: Independent artist quotas were previously merged or one quota could be lost while repairing another.
cases.desired_behavior: Treat every artist quantity as an independent mandatory minimum and preserve all of them through generation, catalogue resolution and refinement.
cases.guidance: Never merge numeric artist requirements into one shared quota. Validate each named artist independently after catalogue resolution.

cases.prompt: the playlist must have 2 metallica, 2 guns n' roses and 2 ac/dc tracks
cases.failure: The numeric artist requirements were ignored and unrelated artists were selected instead; treating them only as minimums could also over-represent the requested artists in a larger playlist.
cases.desired_behavior: Recognize three independent exact final artist counts and ensure the resolved playlist contains exactly two tracks for every named artist.
cases.guidance: A compact mandatory content list such as 'must have 2 Artist A, 2 Artist B and 2 Artist C tracks' expresses independent exact final counts, not one combined preference and not merely minimums.

cases.prompt: Create a playlist of rock music with only live versions
cases.failure: The prompt required live recordings while the live-exclusion checkbox remained active without a visible conflict.
cases.desired_behavior: Block generation and show a conflict until the request or the incompatible exclusion filter is changed.
cases.guidance: Explicit recording-version requirements take priority over creative preferences and must be checked against UI filters before generation.

cases.prompt: the playlist must have 2 metallica, 2 guns n' roses and 2 ac/dc tracks

context.original_prompt: Create a playlist of rock music with only live versions

cases.failure: A later artist refinement could satisfy the new artist request by introducing studio recordings into an already valid all-live playlist.
cases.desired_behavior: Keep the original mandatory live-recording policy when it is already an established invariant of the current playlist, unless the new refinement explicitly supersedes it, while still satisfying the new exact artist counts.
cases.guidance: A refinement preserves an original mandatory recording constraint only when the current playlist actually satisfies that constraint; an established invariant remains active unless explicitly superseded.

cases.prompt: must have 2 metallica, 2 guns n roses and 2 ac/dc songs

context.original_prompt: Create a playlist of rock music with only live versions

cases.failure: A legacy mixed playlist created before live-version enforcement was fixed still carried an old 'only live' prompt. Playlist Studio resurrected that unsatisfied historical constraint and blocked an unrelated artist-count refinement.
cases.desired_behavior: Do not inherit a historical recording-version constraint that the current playlist does not already satisfy. Apply the current artist-count refinement normally, while still preserving recording constraints for playlists where they are genuinely established.
cases.guidance: Constraint inheritance must follow validated playlist state, not prompt history alone. Never turn a previously unsatisfied legacy requirement into a new hidden prerequisite for an unrelated refinement.

cases.failure: Explicit additions must not be treated as a vague preference or as a whole-playlist allow-list.
cases.desired_behavior: Add exactly two new distinct David Bowie tracks while keeping the playlist size unchanged by replacing only the required number of existing tracks.
cases.guidance: Incremental add/include instructions are exact new-track targets and existing tracks by that artist do not count toward the requested additions.

cases.prompt: insert 2 metallica, 2 guns n' roses and 2 ac/dc tracks
cases.failure: A compact multi-artist insertion could be interpreted as a vague refinement and return unrelated replacement artists.
cases.desired_behavior: Add exactly two new distinct tracks for each named artist, independently, while preserving the playlist size.
cases.guidance: When an add/insert verb governs a compact list of count-and-artist pairs, every pair is an exact incremental addition target.

cases.prompt: Crea una playlist di musica italiana dal 2000 ad oggi adatta per un party. il mood deve essere festoso.
cases.failure: The generated playlist broadly matched the Italian repertoire and date range but drifted toward generic well-known songs, including selections weakly aligned with the explicitly requested party use context and festive mood.
cases.desired_behavior: Keep hard eligibility constraints authoritative while treating explicit mood, energy, activity, occasion and listening-context wording as substantive playlist-wide curation objectives across every generation stage.
cases.guidance: Do not reduce a request to broad genre, era, language, country or popularity. After hard constraints are satisfied, explicit mood, energy and listening context must outrank generic popularity, variety and discovery defaults; every selected track should have a defensible role in that context.
